verdict.rationale: TruffleHog documents a `--fail` flag that causes the CLI to exit non-zero when verified/unknown secrets are found (trufflehog-docs-13), which is exactly the exit-code mechanism a CI job needs to fail a build, and the CLI/Docker distribution (trufflehog-gh-2, trufflehog-gh-6) is easily embeddable in any CI pipeline. However, the evidence frames this primarily around pre-commit/pre-receive git hooks rather than an explicit CI-on-PR workflow (e.g., no GitHub Actions/GitLab CI example or docs page for PR-diff scanning is shown). Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI) integration docs or examples showing PR-diff scanning and build-fail behavior, and independent confirmation of CI usage in the wild.
